summary: This showcase demonstrates an Aura-element team tackling the Abyssal Emissary (Area Boss 3) in the Crisis Rally event. The deployed lineup features Talethia, Anneliesis, Diantha, Lincos, and Child of Chaos, reaching over 8 billion damage in the encounter. Full stat sheets, equipment configurations, and precise skill timing delays are provided at the end of the run. All team members' ultimates are synchronized on a 17.5-second recast rotation.
